note: Ratchet for the structural code report (`./gradlew :worker:structureReport`). Every number below is production code that ships and does nothing: classes nothing references, methods only tests call, methods no entry point can reach, methods too big for the JIT, and severe in-loop cost findings. They may only go DOWN — raising a limit to make a build green defeats the point of measuring, so a rise fails the task. The task prints the tightened set whenever the tree improves; paste it here in the same commit.
measured: 2026-08-05, Plan 11 phase 1 (issue #210), on the full tree. 45 methods section 2.3 reported as referenced by nothing at all — tests included — were deleted from :engine (20), :peer (16), :storage (6) and :neoforge-mod (3), taking one nested record (`SoakMetrics.Snapshot`) with them once its only producer was gone. never_referenced_methods 136 -> 93, unreachable_methods 267 -> 264. test_only_methods stays at 415 on purpose: seven deletions would have PROMOTED a method into that set by removing its last production caller (HeartbeatMonitor's no-arg constructor, ContraptionMigrator.Groups', PeerRuntime's two TickSync delegates, CommitteeMember#sign, and two ChunkTicketService accessors), so those seven were kept — a ratchet you tighten in one column by loosening another has not measured anything. Section 2.5 could not be cut at all from this territory: every method in it is referenced by production code, and each cluster terminates in a record's canonical constructor, an @Override whose declaration lives in a frozen module, or a method a test calls — none of which this phase is allowed to touch.
